_readme: STAGE 2c, THE TELESCOPE: A 1 KM STONE'S CAVITY RESOLVED WHERE IT FALLS (2026-10-27, docs/WATER_V2.md
14.4). The 1 km stone of impact_newburyport_1km.json (1950 DA's class) into 35 N 42 W at 15:00Z on

2026-08-28, 2625 km from the Merrimack's mouth: its 19 km cavity is three tail cells, so the event gets a patch of its own (rank 6, 880 m cells, 450 km) the batch it is imposed, nested in the tail and folding into it; the train crosses the tail to the window (the spin-up starts
before it). The gate: the tail's
arrival at the window against the ray's sqrt(g h) over the tail's bed ('[impact] stage 2b' says it) within 10 %;
the probe line every sim-minute ('tail: at the anchor ..., east of the window ...'). The window itself does not
survive this stone: its +11 m crest at the bar collapses the step and the spin-up stops there, said in the log.
